statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: q,v,c,d>0, p,b,t>=0: if some delta in [0,d] has P(delta) = cvt(q+delta) - (t+q+delta){cv delta + c delta^2 + v(d-delta)^2} >= 0 then the source q f0+p f2+t f3+b f12+c f15+v f13+d f26 has Phi >= 0 on SO(4) (pointwise); also with q,v swapped.

statements.label: capacity matrix
statements.restatement: P(delta) = det M(delta); Schur complement [[W,K],[K,t-K]]; equivalent PSD certificate.

statements.label: simple section
statements.restatement: delta = dv/(c+v): q(c+v)>d^2 and t >= d(v+d){q(c+v)+dv}/((c+v){q(c+v)-d^2}) suffices.

statements.label: example
statements.restatement: d=1, q=100, v=c=1/50: t >= 680/19 suffices for all p,b >= 0.
